NGDP_RPCH.label: Real GDP Growth
NGDP_RPCH.description: Annual percentage change in real GDP.
NGDP_RPCH.typical_country_risk_interpretation: Lower or negative growth may increase sovereign risk and weaken fiscal resilience.

PCPIPCH.label: Inflation
PCPIPCH.description: Annual percentage change in consumer prices.
PCPIPCH.typical_country_risk_interpretation: Higher inflation may increase policy tightening risk, FX pressure, and sovereign risk premium.

GGXWDG_NGDP.label: Government Debt / GDP
GGXWDG_NGDP.description: General government gross debt as a percentage of GDP.
GGXWDG_NGDP.typical_country_risk_interpretation: Higher debt burden may increase sovereign vulnerability.

BCA_NGDPD.label: Current Account Balance / GDP
BCA_NGDPD.description: Current account balance as a percentage of GDP.
BCA_NGDPD.typical_country_risk_interpretation: A stronger current account position may reduce external financing risk.

GGXCNL_NGDP.label: Fiscal Balance / GDP
GGXCNL_NGDP.description: General government net lending or borrowing as a percentage of GDP.
GGXCNL_NGDP.typical_country_risk_interpretation: Larger fiscal deficits may increase borrowing needs and sovereign risk.

LUR.label: Unemployment Rate
LUR.description: Unemployment rate as a percentage of the labour force.
LUR.typical_country_risk_interpretation: Higher unemployment may signal weak domestic demand and social pressure.
